be a morphism of ringed topoi. If <MATH_0002> has enough points, then
the pullback of a K-flat complex of
<MATH_0003>-modules is a K-flat complex of <MATH_0004>-modules.

This follows from Lemma <REF_0001>,
Modules on Sites, Lemma <REF_0002>,
and
More on Algebra, Lemma <REF_0003>.
